content: Aristotle was an ancient Greek philosopher and polymath who made groundbreaking contributions to logic, metaphysics, mathematics, physics, biology, botany, ethics, politics, agriculture, medicine, dance, and theatre, and was a key figure in the development of Western philosophy.
